trace.final:
**Summary:**

1. **Diagnosis**: checkout-api on v2.3.1 was unhealthy across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. Deployment history showed v2.3.0 was the most recent release healthy in production.
2. **Rollback**: Rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all production regions. Verified post-rollback: all regions healthy, error rate down to 0.2%.
3. **Incident**: Opened SEV2 incident **INC-0002** (on-call paged) documenting the unhealthy v2.3.1 deploy, the rollback to v2.3.0, and verification results — with a note that v2.3.1 (and its staging rc) should be investigated before any re-deploy.

One note: the first attempt to create the incident returned a 502; I retried with an idempotency key, so there is exactly one open incident.
